name: EventGallery - Small Screen Cap
description: The homepage photo wall with its small-screen cap of 12. On a phone it shows four rows of three and a 'Show all 38 photos' button; on a tablet three rows of four and the same button; on desktop the full 38-photo wall with no button, exactly as before. The cap exists because the uncapped wall ran to about 2,500px of scrolling on a 390px phone (responsive pass, 2026-10-16).
